nora.k: bringing up pegasus-x13b-4q on canary. seeing intermittent OOMs during long-chat jobs when callers request >7k tokens. looks like KV cache growth + fragmentation.
sam.v: paste the worker stderr when you have it
nora.k: snippet:
```
E worker: RuntimeError: CUDA OOM while allocating KV cache chunk (1.2 GiB)
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```
pete.m: is this after the default max_new_tokens bump to 5k last sprint or ad-hoc overrides?
nora.k: manifest default is 5000 for pegasus-x13b-4q. some internal users request up to 12k.
lisa.z: quick mitigations: 1) gateway soft-cap at 6k with friendly 409 + docs link; 2) per-model hard_cap at manifest (10k); 3) runtime knobs: reduce microbatch_size, lower batch_window_ms, and try kv_eviction + trim heuristics. tradeoffs: latency and throughput.
sam.v: for similar 13B quant models we got wins with kv_eviction_threshold=0.58, trim_ratio=0.15, prefetch=false, microbatch_size=2 and batch_window_ms=14. also consider kv_compact for defragmentation.
nora.k: ran a quick ablation (100 runs each): baseline (default) -> 8 OOMs; cap2048+microbatch1 -> 0 OOMs but tail latency +33%; kv_evict=0.58+trim=0.15+compact+prefetch=false+microbatch2 -> 1 OOM, latency ~baseline.
pete.m: can you paste the exact config you tested?
nora.k: config snippet:
```json
{
  "model":"pegasus-x13b-4q",
  "defaults":{"max_new_tokens":5000},
  "batching":{"microbatch_size":2, "batch_window_ms":14},
  "prefetch":false,
  "kv":{"eviction_threshold":0.58, "trim_ratio":0.15, "compact":true}
}
```
lisa.z: also think about kernel selection: avoid long-sequence attention kernels for >4k by default to prevent allocating large temporary attention buffers. But if we change kernels, run long-context QA/summaries to check quality.
qa-bot: kicked off full regression + long-context evals for pegasus-x13b-4q (summarization, multi-hop QA, hallucination checks). ETA ~25m.
ops-bot: canary deploy queued for pegasus-x13b-4q tag canary/kv-0.58 at 2025-04-02T11:00:00Z :rocket:
sam.v: early eval smoke from 5-min run: kv tweak + prefetch=false shows ROUGE delta ~0.06% on long summary tasks and no meaningful hallucination drift. cap2048 preserved quality but latency spike.
lisa.z: recommendation: 1) roll kv_eviction_threshold=0.58 + trim_ratio=0.15 + compact=true to canary 10% traffic, 2) keep default max_new_tokens=5000 but add gateway soft-cap at 6k and manifest hard_cap=10k, 3) add per-model OOM alarm (OOM_count/hour > 0.4%) with auto-fallback to pegasus-x13b-16q, 4) collect token-length histograms for last 48h to revisit defaults.
pete.m: I'll open PRs for manifest + gateway + alarm. PR #5288.
qa-bot: full eval finished: ROUGE delta 0.04% with kv_compact+prefetch=false, multi-hop QA EM and hallucination metrics stable.
ops-bot: canary ramp to 10% scheduled at 2025-04-02T11:30:00Z  monitoring hooks attached.
nora.k: rolling to 10% after PR merges. will watch token-level OOM counts and tail latency. if OOMs spike auto-fallback will route to non-quant variant.
sam.v: followups: update long-gen playbook, support KB explaining soft/hard caps and whitelist flow, and add a short note to partners.
nora.k: assigned followups. closing thread once canary stable. :white_check_mark:
